newsitem.title: USA: Dave & Busters Q4 preliminary revs $27 mln.
newsitem.headline: Dave & Busters Q4 preliminary revs $27 mln.

text.p: Dave & Buster's Inc said on Thursday its preliminary revenue estimate was $27 million for the fourth quarter and $88.5 million for the full year.
The company, which operates nine large restaurant and entertainment complexes, also said it would accelerate its development program starting in fiscal 1998.
Dave & Buster's planned to open four stores in fiscal 1998 and another four stores in fiscal 1999. Beginning in fiscal 2000, the company said it aimed to open a minimum of five stores per year.

It also said its Ontario, Calif. store would open 30 days earlier than had been anticipated. Its second location for 1997 would be Cincinnati, Ohio, which would open in the middle of the third quarter, the company said.
The Rockland County, N.Y. location would open in the fourth quarter, and the first store set to open in fiscal 1998 would be in Denver, Colorado, it said.
